body.heading: Where in the world is Djibouti?
paragraphs: Djibouti is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Djibouti is Djibouti.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Djibouti speak Somali, Afar, Arabic and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Djibouti is the Djiboutian franc.

body.heading: How big is Djibouti?
paragraphs: Djibouti covers about 23,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of The Gambia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Lake Assal is the lowest point in Africa — a dazzling white salt lake below sea level, ringed by black lava fields. It looks like another planet.
High in the Goda Mountains, the Day Forest is a cool, misty woodland of ancient juniper trees — a green surprise in a desert country, home to rare birds.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Djibouti on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
